# Support Guidelines for Vyomix · Earth Query Lens

Welcome to the **Vyomix · Earth Query Lens** support center. We appreciate your interest in our satellite intelligence and multimodal remote sensing platform.

---

## Getting Help

Before opening an issue or inquiry, please review the resources below:

### 1. Project Documentation
- **Architecture & Features:** Refer to the comprehensive [README.md](../README.md) for architectural diagrams, dual-spectrum radar pipelines, and mathematical area formulas.
- **In-Browser ONNX Setup:** Refer to `src/lib/onnxInference.ts` for documentation on local WebAssembly tensor execution.
- **Security & Privacy:** Consult [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for local data storage and zero-telemetry protocols.

### 2. Community Discussions
For general questions, satellite data formatting questions (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 Optical, Landsat 8/9), or feature discussions:
- Join the conversation on [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/SmartKidzee/vyomixsih/discussions).
- Search previous topics to verify if your question has already been answered.

### 3. Reporting Bugs
If you have identified a verifiable defect or unexpected behavior:
- Check existing issues in the [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/SmartKidzee/vyomixsih/issues) to avoid duplicates.
- Submit a detailed report using the [Bug Report Template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md).

### 4. Security Vulnerabilities
If you have discovered a potential security vulnerability:
- Do **not** post security details in public issues or discussions.
- File a report privately through the [GitHub Security Advisory Portal](https://github.com/SmartKidzee/vyomixsih/security/advisories/new).
- The maintainers review advisories promptly in accordance with our security disclosure policy.
